This includes pursuing continuous improvement initiatives to adapt to global needs and challenges through innovation and integration. Departmental efforts towards continuous improvement have included several measures that serve as the basis for the pillar’s approach to continuous improvement.
history.board_assessment: Given that the reform implementation plan, which was part of the continuous improvement mechanism, is being developed, the Board considers this recommendation implemented.
